text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services recommends stop control for westbound traffic at the uncontrolled intersection of Hartismere Court and Collingdale Road (southwest intersection) and for northbound traffic at the uncontrolled intersection for Hartismere Court and Hartismere Court.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of a compulsory stop control for westbound traffic on Hartismere Court at the southwest intersection of Collingdale Road. 2. Approved the installation of a compulsory stop control for northbound traffic on Hartismere Court at the intersection of Hartismere Court.
